upstream.name: PSTACK
upstream.relationship: versioned design evidence only; no code or skill is vendored or required at runtime

principles.localInvariant: Hardening and remediation assert observable behavior rather than private implementation.
Every claim needs executable clean-code and targeted-mutant proof.
Native mutation engines perform deterministic fault injection; agents interpret evidence.
Baseline, discovery, remediation, import, and joined verification are separate gates.
Mutation worktrees never merge; only guarded test and fixture changes cross the boundary.
Results distinguish immutable engine status, human triage, and workflow completion.
Parallel lanes require disjoint behavior and test ownership before shared report integration.

reviewTrigger: Re-read and re-approve the mapped local invariants whenever the audited upstream revision or any recorded blob changes. Runtime behavior remains local until that review is accepted.
